title: The inactive refusal toast fades after 3 seconds and carries the line Please try to resolve this.
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I2 is inactive here. An open work order at Staging Heavy Duty. Two browser tabs (A and B) on Staging Heavy Duty, and a stopwatch.
custom_steps:
1. Tab A: Parts > Inventory > Inactive tab > the actions menu > Activate parts; tick QAPL-I2, click Activate and confirm Activate.
  2. Tab B: open the work order > a line > Add Part; pick QAPL-I2, Qty 1; do not save yet.
  3. Tab A: Active tab > the actions menu > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-I2, click Deactivate and confirm Deactivate.
  4. Tab B: click Save in the Part dialog; start the stopwatch when the toast appears.
  5. Do not touch the toast; watch it.
  6. Close the Part dialog and reload the work order.
custom_expected:
1. "1 part updated."; QAPL-I2 moves to the Active tab.
  2. QAPL-I2 is offered and selected.
  3. "1 part updated."; QAPL-I2 is back on the Inactive tab.
  4. The server refuses the save: an error toast reads "QAPL-I2 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." with a second, smaller line under it: "Please try to resolve this."
  5. The toast fades on its own after about 3 seconds.
  6. No QAPL-I2 part or part request was added to the line.
